RWA.note: Article concerns person-to-person switching, not e-procurement.

facts.fact: The article says eKash, the national instant payment system run by switch operator RSwitch, has operated for four months, with rollout starting in July 2026 under a directive by the National Bank of Rwanda that requires interoperable transfers between licensed institutions.

systems.tiers: banks, mobile money providers, SACCOs, microfinance institutions

facts.fact: The New Times reports eKash, in operation for four months from July 2026, connects banks, mobile money providers, SACCOs and microfinance institutions through a single national payment infrastructure for account-to-account, account-to-wallet, wallet-to-account and wallet-to-wallet transfers between institutions.
